selection_basis: Highest historical all-case correct count within known recorded size classes; native Q8 Flash selected from a tie; GLiClass9B added as a different-family held-out-test counterpoint. This does not predict new-pack performance.

historical_anchor.policy: New archive per candidate/runtime; historical archives unchanged; never pool accuracy across packs.

technical_canary.selection_rule: Lexically first calibration family per track; all four FR/EN and catalogue variants. No choice based on gold or predictions.
technical_canary.limitations: Three families do not represent all tasks or maximum native input lengths; validate native encodings over all 192 inputs separately.

expected_volumes.definition: Planned one-pass volumes, not observed calls. Optional calibration repeats/diagnostics are separate and never added to quality denominators.

execution_rules: No launch, download, paid API or service change is performed by reading this plan.
Use the explicitly validated --dataset native supervisor with one new campaign per session; its historical 132+Mastra default remains available.
Do not run historical Linux-wheel CPU locks as if they were qualified macOS environments. Pin and validate a platform-specific runtime, or run the original WSL environment explicitly.
New quantization, model revision, helper, backend, runtime build or device is a separate observation.
Admit one model at a time under fixed candidate-specific memory/time guards; preserve at least the existing 8 GiB reserve or a stricter profile requirement.
Verify all input encodings without truncation, then the calibration canary. A structurally valid wrong choice does not fail the technical gate.
Freeze profiles, prompts and budgets before full-pack predictions. If an envelope needs measurement, use only calibration and record it before the test.
Archive canary, anchor and new-pack phases separately; release workers between phases and record cache/cold-start limitations.
Run full 132 and full 192 packs for every technically admitted candidate. Do not stop or select candidates based on test accuracy.
Keep errors, missing, unsupported, timeout and abstention distinct. A resource stop yields a partial archive and full denominator, never a silent smaller benchmark.
Compare matching case IDs within each pack; group uncertainty by scenario family. Old and new families are not paired with each other.
Catalogue-view differences combine length, distractors and position shifts; they are not an isolated causal effect of tool count.
Pair compact/expanded outputs within family and language, and FR/EN outputs within family and catalogue view; retain correctness and status transitions and group uncertainty by family.

optional_after_initial_cohort.purpose: Quantization/memory contrast with Flash Q8, as a separate arm.
Small alternative-family control; decision-only backbone, not a class quality winner or qualified Vela span/router.
Optional native-stack technical control, not the selected sub-1B quality representative.

deferred: D3 Ultra/Turbo and GLiClass27B require distinct model/runtime/resource audits. Historical D3Q4 identifies neither Ultra nor Turbo.
Vela3 specialized adapters require their own task contracts and scorers.
Free-form tool sets, executable arguments, adaptive MCP episodes and empirical model-routing policies are separate harness work.
